comment: The file was saved by the integration tip before the move, 9aa382742e, whose Hard Mix was the base modules' hard_mix module: a 512 by 256 document, the backdrop grey 0.2 on the left chunk and 0.6 on the right, Layer 1 filled (0.5, 0.9, 2.5) and set to Hard Mix. That build read (0, 1, 2.5) composited at (128, 128) and (1, 1, 2.5) at (384, 128).

The layers step reads each layer's blend id off the document, so Layer 1 has to answer hard_mix, the id the old build wrote, now the skeleton's mode, and the modules block of the state dump has no hard_mix module loaded.
